programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes

programs.title: The Chef's Garden
programs.desc: Cassidee Dabney, executive chef of the Barn at Blackberry Farm in Walland, Tennessee, visits The Chef's Garden for the first time to meet Farmer Lee and celebrate her passion for seasonal vegetables. A champion of the underdog, Chef Cassidee chooses the humble onion, often seen as a supporting player, to shine in her whey braised onion and fresh cheese dish.

programs.title: The Chef's Garden
programs.desc: Jerome Darby, executive chef at Olivier Cheng Catering and Events in New York City, explores the lettuce fields of The Chef's Garden with Farmer Lee Jones, checking out the varieties that will appear at high-end fashion events he caters for. Using his background in fashion, design, and style, Jerome transforms petite lettuce into a stunning seasonal vegetable dish that truly steals the show.
